# Radio log

## What gets logged

Every call on channel sixteen is logged with the time, the callsign and a
one-line summary. A call that is only a radio check is logged as a check and
nothing more.

## Mistakes

The log is never torn out, only struck through. A struck line stays legible, and
the keeper who struck it adds initials and the time beside it.

## Handover

At the evening handover the outgoing keeper reads the last six entries aloud,
and the incoming keeper signs under the final line.
